answer.reason: Only the Barak and Sisera passage tells an event at Tabor; the rest is a tribal border, comparisons, a figure of speech and a doubtful namesake.

clauses.english: was where Barak went up against Sisera, then came down with ten thousand men
clauses.quote: So Barak went down from mount Tabor, and ten thousand men after him.

doubts: JDG 8:18 (men slain at Tabor by Zebah and Zalmunna) may mean a different place, so it was left out.
JOS 19:22 only names Tabor on Issachar's border; PSA 89:12, JER 46:18 and HOS 5:1 use it in praise, comparison or figure, so none were used.
